description: Generate 1-4 alternative versions of selected sections (top-level blocks) of the campaign email or of one ready variation. Saves no variation or email content (a company's first AI generation saves its inferred email design direction, like generate_email): each option has name, summary and replacements (new versions of the selected blocks with the same ids). Changes outside the selected sections are dropped, and options that change nothing are left out. Runs synchronously and can take up to a minute. Apply one with update_campaign_variation.

companyId.description: Company ID. If omitted, uses the currently selected company.

sectionIds.description: Ids of top-level blocks to vary.

style.description: How far to move from the source: close edits it and keeps its style and structure; fresh writes each version anew with its own structure in the brand's colors and fonts; bold also gives each its own look (a theme of its own). Defaults to close for branches of a variation and fresh otherwise.

variationId.description: Vary this variation's sections. Omit to vary the email's saved content.

name: generate_campaign_variation_section_options

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `generate_campaign_variation_section_options` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

options.description: List of section option records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
